scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/OxSteed.xcarchive archive
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
